name: Vale AST Automated Verbal Linting Engine
diagnostic: How is verbal brand governance enforced—through static PDF style manuals, or via automated AST linting within continuous integration pipelines?
artifact: A `.vale.ini` configuration paired with custom YAML style rules enforcing tone boundaries, banned terminology, and reading ease during build time.
trap: Writing broad, complex regex patterns that throw frequent false positives, leading engineering and writing teams to disable the linter.
